queer_characters.name: Ronit
queer_characters.notes: A New York photographer who left her Orthodox community after being caught in a romantic relationship with Esti; the film centers her rekindled same-sex relationship as a driving emotional arc.

queer_characters.name: Esti
queer_characters.notes: Married within the Orthodox community, she grapples with her true identity, rekindles her relationship with Ronit, and ultimately leaves her marriage to pursue her own life; the source labels her a lesbian though her arc explores identity within a repressive religious context.
